summary: Lyntris Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the pricing of its initial public offering at $17.50 per share on August 18, 2026. The company sold 5,714,286 primary shares while selling stockholders sold 11,285,714 shares, totaling 17,000,000 shares. Underwriters received a 30-day option for 2,550,000 additional shares from selling stockholders. The IPO closed August 20, 2026, with Evercore, Citigroup, and Guggenheim as representatives. Customary 180/360-day lock-ups apply. This is a routine IPO pricing event, not a special situation; watch for overhang from the large secondary component and lock-up expirations.
